name: USDC Permissionless IG Diversified Income
description: Blends the two permissionless sources of return — over-collateralised DeFi lending and permissionless private credit (Syrup) — alongside tokenised RWA income via Ondo Global Markets. It targets an investment-grade-oriented, diversified income profile while keeping to a deliberately small and stable set of markets. Allocation is non-discretionary and rules-based, with programmed rebalancing and CoinShares managing the risk framework only. No leverage, no recursive lending.
assetManagerDescription: CoinShares is a pioneering digital asset investment firm founded in 2014. The company launched the first regulated Bitcoin fund and the first open-ended crypto ETP in Europe. As the market leader with ~45% share of European crypto ETP assets, CoinShares combines deep institutional expertise with a decade-long track record in regulated digital asset management.

name: Armitage Leveraged ETH Yield
description: WETH strategy run by Armitage, Wintermute's vault curation arm. It allocates to three Armitage vaults: a wstETH/ETH loop (about 40%), WETH lent to Wintermute on Wildcat (about 20%) and a Morpho wstETH-collateral USDC borrow (25–35%), and keeps 5–15% idle for redemptions.

name: CoinShares IG Diversified Income
description: Blends the two permissionless sources of return — over-collateralised DeFi lending and permissionless private credit (Syrup) — alongside tokenised RWA income via Ondo Global Markets. It targets an investment-grade-oriented, diversified income profile while keeping to a deliberately small and stable set of markets. Allocation is non-discretionary and rules-based, with programmed rebalancing and CoinShares managing the risk framework only. No leverage, no recursive lending.

name: CoinShares IG Diversified Income (Permissioned)
description: Allowlisted twin of CoinShares IG Diversified Income. Deployed but unused: CoinShares' permissioned track moved to Institutional Diversified Yield.

name: CoinShares DeFi Income
description: CoinShares' DeFi-only USDC strategy, open to any depositor: lending on Aave and on Morpho Blue markets against BTC and ETH collateral, plus a CoinShares-run vault. No real-world assets.

name: CoinShares Institutional Diversified Yield
description: CoinShares' allowlisted USDC strategy for institutional capital. Its yield sources sit in one CoinShares vault: tokenised US Treasury funds (Ondo, OUSG), Spiko money-market funds, Ethena, Compound and Maple secured lending.

name: Armitage wstETH/ETH Loop
description: Armitage vault running a leveraged staking loop: it supplies wstETH on Aave (Morpho as an alternative), borrows WETH against it and mints more wstETH, earning Lido's staking yield above the WETH borrow rate.

name: Armitage Wildcat Lending to Wintermute
description: Armitage vault lending WETH on Wildcat (market token wmtWETH) with Wintermute as the borrower: a credit line to one counterparty, not a collateralised market.

name: Armitage Morpho wstETH Borrow
description: Armitage vault posting wstETH as collateral on Morpho Blue, borrowing USDC against it and deploying the USDC in stablecoin lending.

name: CoinShares IG Real-World Assets
description: CoinShares vault holding the real-world-asset leg of IG Diversified Income: Ondo tokenised US Treasury funds (SGOVon, USFRon), bought through CoW Swap with every fill checked against a Chainlink price feed. Redeems on CoinShares' settlement cycle.

name: CoinShares DeFi Income Vault
description: CoinShares-run vault behind DeFi Income, for the positions that have no Railnet Vehicle of their own. Redeems on CoinShares' settlement cycle.

name: CoinShares Institutional Diversified Yield Vault
description: CoinShares vault behind Institutional Diversified Yield, holding its yield sources: Ondo tokenised Treasury funds and OUSG, Spiko money-market funds, Ethena, Compound and Maple's High Yield Secured Lending pool. Redeems on CoinShares' settlement cycle.
